title: Adah
summary: A wife of Lamech, and the mother of Jabal and Jubal (Genesis 4:19–21). Raleigh prints Ada.
description: A wife of Lamech, and the mother of Jabal and Jubal (Genesis 4:19–21). Raleigh prints Ada, beside Silla, Iubal, Tubal, and Tubalcain. No mother or spouse field is stored, so Lamech is Related and is not recorded as her father. Undated in this intake: no CFAH year was found. Raleigh is display-only.
